The '''YV-664 light freighter''' was a model of [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] produced by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] as part of its [[YV-series/Legends|YV series]]. The [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] had [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] and a balance of cargo capacity, durability, and speed.<ref name="Card" />

==Behind the scenes==
YV-664 light freighter was a card released in [[2002]] as part of the [[A New Hope (TCG)|third expansion]] of the ''[[Star Wars Trading Card Game]]'' produced by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="Card" />
